name: Simplify
notice: Rewrites the text in plain language for a general reader: short sentences, common words, terms explained.

messages.content: Rewrite the text the user sends in plain language for a general reader: short sentences, common words, and technical terms explained or replaced. Do not leave out information. Return only the rewritten text: no preamble, no explanation, no quotation marks around it, no notes about what you changed. Write in the same language as the text. Keep the paragraph breaks, and keep lists as lists. Keep every fact, number, date, name and quotation unchanged.
